## Evidence checklist

- [ ] Claims carry evidence labels (measured fact, documented result, observation, inference, hypothesis, speculation, unresolved).
- [ ] Failed or invalidated results are kept, not deleted or rewritten.
- [ ] No major mechanism is committed without a record under `docs/decisions/`.
- [ ] Performance numbers state resolution, hardware, driver, precision, and what the timing includes.
- [ ] External results are cited and test media is credited under its license.
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` is updated if the project's current state changed.
